fee_baseline.policy: fee schedule is a model input and must be refreshed from the actual account tier/staking/referral state before live routing

measurement_contract.economic_comparison: same economic asset, equal entry notional, equal holding horizon
measurement_contract.spread: full quoted spread in bps; round-trip model charges half-spread on entry plus half-spread on exit
measurement_contract.slippage: entry plus exit expected VWAP impact beyond the quoted half-spread; never add full VWAP impact again
measurement_contract.live_depth: derive displayed bid/ask USD depth from the Hyperliquid l2Book snapshot and use min(bid_depth, ask_depth) as conservative two-sided capacity diagnostic
measurement_contract.vwap: consume returned l2Book levels to the target quantity for buy and sell VWAP; Hyperliquid returns at most 20 levels per side, so insufficient returned depth is a measurement/capacity failure rather than an extrapolation
measurement_contract.spot_l2_identity: resolve the runtime @spot_pair_index from spotMeta before l2Book fetch; UI display names are not assumed to be HyperCore asset IDs
measurement_contract.funding_api_unit: Hyperliquid funding values are decimal rate per hour; convert to bps/hour by multiplying by 10000 before cost accumulation
measurement_contract.funding: signed bps per hour for a long; positive means long pays, negative means long receives; multiply by explicit holding hours
measurement_contract.basis: perp premium in bps versus verified spot; relative cost contribution is entry premium minus expected exit premium
measurement_contract.custody_redemption: explicit spot-only friction in bps when economically relevant; do not invent bridge/redemption cost when no such operational movement is assumed
